info.name: Airline Booking System API - Automated Test Suite
info.description:
Complete Postman test collection for the Airline Booking System microservices backend.

All requests are routed through the API Gateway (port 8080).

Features:
- Comprehensive test scripts (status code, schema validation, response time, headers)
- Automated variable chaining (tokens, user IDs, flight IDs, booking IDs, PNRs, payment references)
- Positive & negative / error test scenarios (400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict, 503 Fallback)
- Full End-to-End user booking journey
- Dynamic pre-request data generation to allow seamless Newman and Postman Runner executions.
